description:
Hi, I’m Chris. On Mr Wolf, I focus on motorcycle electrical systems and real-world diagnostics.

This channel isn’t about quick fixes. It’s about understanding how ignition and electrical systems actually work, and how to properly troubleshoot them step by step.

NO More OEM parts? Don't Worry!

I design and build custom AC and DC CDI units, voltage regulators, and high-quality DIY electronic solutions for motorcycles whose original parts are no longer available. My goal is not just to replace components, but to improve reliability and performance through proper testing and engineering.

If you’re interested in ignition systems Upgrades, wiring diagnostics and Troubleshooting ,and bringing older bikes back to life the right way, you’ll feel at home here.
